name: bentOS: This Portfolio
shortDescription: This site: a static Next.js 16 + Tailwind 4 portfolio laid out as a bento tray, with project content as plain JSON.
description:
The site you're on. It's being rebuilt: the first version (boot screen, 3D viewer, physics-driven project grid, mini-games and chat assistant) is archived at the `v1-bentos` tag, and the new version is a simpler static Next.js site laid out as a bento tray of compartments, with a CRT-style accent used for system info.

Project content is plain JSON read at build time.
